derivation: probably contracted from (compound of G2811 (κλέος) and G3962 (πατήρ));

occurrences.text: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
